greeting.text: Hi, I'm Abu, based in Shanghai
greeting.description:
I'm an enterprise AI production engineer: I help teams turn knowledge Q&A, document processing, and assistants into systems that are deployable, measurable, and maintainable.
If search is wrong, parsing is broken, or assistants will not ship — send me the status quo.
